en.title: Prudential Faces 5.2 Billion Yen Damages from Employee Misconduct; Investigation Cites Excessive Sales Pressure
en.summary: Prudential Life Insurance reported approximately 5.2 billion yen in damages from unauthorized financial transactions by sales staff. An external investigation attributed the misconduct to corporate culture overly emphasizing sales performance, leading the company to revise compensation systems and introduce guaranteed minimum salaries.

en.title: Prime Minister Takaki Denies 'Political Propaganda' Over Tenfold Budget Increase for Cabinet Public Affairs Office
en.summary: Prime Minister Takaki requested 7.2 billion yen for the Cabinet Public Affairs Office's fiscal 2027 budget, ten times the previous year's allocation. The prime minister stated the increase funds necessary communication enhancement rather than political promotion, responding to social media criticism about government spending.
